body:
Founder: 'when i hit T it started typing into chat - thats not even a functioning feature just remap that key to spray please and ensure there is a spray interface in the client HAVE IT REPLACE TDMO in the shankpit menu.' New packages/world/spray_registry.h (reuses level_boxes.h's own curl fetch). LOBBY_TDMO -> LOBBY_SPRAYS in the same menu slot, opens a real spray select overlay (mirrors level_select_menu exactly) against the live IDUNA sprays registry, auto-selects the real default. T now raycasts via trace_map and places a real decal (position/normal/scene/spray id) on hit, rendered as an honest flat-tinted placeholder quad (no native PNG decoder exists yet, named not hidden). Live-verified under Xvfb: menu screenshot confirms SPRAYS replaced TDMO, opening it lists the founder's own real sprays with default pre-selected; debug pass confirmed a real raycast hit + visible rendered decal. All temp test code removed. Commit 1c9ca15.

⚓ ☃
title: Ship native sprays menu + T-key remap
